final: WITH account_averages AS (SELECT t.account_id, d.A3 AS region, AVG(CASE WHEN t.type = 'PRIJEM' THEN t.amount WHEN t.type = 'VYDAJ' THEN -t.amount END) AS avg_signed_amount, AVG(t.balance) AS avg_balance FROM trans AS t JOIN account AS a ON t.account_id = a.account_id JOIN district AS d ON a.district_id = d.district_id GROUP BY t.account_id, d.A3), region_averages AS (SELECT region, AVG(avg_signed_amount) AS avg_account_amount, AVG(avg_balance) AS avg_account_balance FROM account_averages GROUP BY region) SELECT region, avg_account_amount, avg_account_balance, avg_account_amount / (SELECT AVG(avg_account_amount) FROM region_averages) AS ratio_to_overall_mean FROM region_averages WHERE (SELECT AVG(avg_account_amount) FROM region_averages) IS NOT NULL
